The explicit source_hash=null fix works: group detail returns 200, the old /studio/question-reports list returns source_hash '' with no user_id, priorities gives group_id 'S|1|q|' and round-trips, and a review update persists. Student requests get 403 and foreign attempts get 404. Preservation holds: 144 sets, 11800 questions, solutions 5939 ready / 1161 paused, 3 tejas_jobs (all done), no TEST_* attempts/sets/jobs/reports/saved/cohorts left. No model or provider calls. UI, using seeded fixtures (since cleaned), at 1920x800 and 390x844: (1) SetDetail on a set with no numeric_rule shows 3 list items and no blank bullet. (2) The home corner reads '0N / CHOOSE EXAM', nowrap, one line 13px high, inside the card at both widths. (3) The progress chart legend has paddingTop 14px with an 11px gap below the 'Mock attempt #' label at both widths; 10 points. (4) Typography unchanged: 66% gauge Roboto Mono 700 40px; 165 / 250 and 90% at 26px desktop / 22px mobile. (5) MyTests calendar at 390, tested with real touch taps (hasTouch context): day and nav cells 44x44; popover x=35..369 / 48..382 and y=322..713, inside both edges. Tap select sets start=2026-10-20. Keyboard select (focus, ArrowRight, Enter) sets end=2026-10-06, which shows 'Start date must be before the end date.' with Retry and Clear dates. Clear dates removes start/end/page, keeps tab/exam=JEE Main/q=TEST_JR, the error disappears and the list reloads (17 attempts); both triggers reset to 'Choose date'. The per-popover Clear date also works. No horizontal overflow. (6) Card accuracy: retake 25/40 card shows 62.5% and the comparison dialog row shows 50% vs 62.5%, delta +12.5 accuracy points and +55 marks. The COMEDK 0/0 card shows 'Accuracy unavailable'. BITSAT 10/20 = 50% and 60/90 = 66.7%. (7) Studio groups: same question with hash A/B/null gives 3 separate groups. Pagination testids carry the full group_id and are unique; Next goes to 2/2 and Previous is enabled. The legacy group shows 'Legacy source identity not recorded'; singular '1 profile' / '1 report'. The Reviewing action moves the report (filter shows Reviewing 1, Reopen button appears). Dates use en-IN ('22 Oct 2026, 9:55 pm'). No overflow at 390.
